This clash feels a bit too similar to this other pending-approval clash: https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/150528b53947261beffa99613e8d4cffb4421c. My comment there also applies to this clash. Let's see what others think

Could you also write out what a | b means in words (i.e., that b is divisible by a)? I think few clashers would be able to understand the mathematical notation here.

Lastly, please add some test cases where a = b and a, b > 1; LCD = GCD = a = b.
Thank you!

@User123 beat me to it! I completely agree with their comment, and I'd just add/refine some points:

Title / Goal
* The term "Least Common Denominator" (LCD) is used in the context of adding or subtracting fractions, which isn't the case here. The correct term for this clash is "Least Common Multiple" (LCM).

Goal
* Please remove the extra right bracket in "gcd(a,b))".

* Please remove the extra right bracket in "lcd(a,b])".

* Please simplify the definitions of GCD and LCM without using the "|" notation, as some players may be unfamiliar with its mathematical meaning (divisibility) and may confuse it with the bitwise OR oeprator.

Input
* Please correct the typo: seperated => separated.

Output
* Please describe the conditions in plain English instead of using programming syntax such as "==" and "elsif".

Cases
* Consider renaming the case "LCD(a,b) = b" (Test 3) to "LCD(a,b) = max(a,b)".

* Consider standardising the use of & and && in the names of Tests 9 and 10.

* Please add a new pair of cases where s = 1, a = b and 100 ≤ a, b ≤ 999.

* Please add a new pair of cases where s = -1, a = b and 100 ≤ a, b ≤ 999.

Thanks.
By the way, the game modes enabled in this clash are different from that enabled in the quoted clash, and the required logic is also different, so I guess it's fine and not treat this as a duplicate.

Thank you. A few points to fix:

Title
* Please change GCL to GCD.

Goal
* Please remove the extra bracket after "gcd(a,b)".

* Please format all three instances of "c" as [[variables]] instead of {{constants}}.

Output
* Please change "gcd(a)" to "gcd(a,b)".

Constraints
* Please format "s" as a [[variable]].

Thanks.

So, I am thinking about doing a clash with fractional artihmetics.
Two fractions and then add,subtract,multiply and divide
With additions and subtraction having equal denominators, and no reduction of fractions. I think this would be be a  good clash.

Then extend it for a puzzle, including different methods of displaying rational numbers.

Just for your reference, existing clashes on fraction operations:

* addition: https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/616947a007a3e0bf3736bff116b66d6ccab4a

* subtraction: can't find any

* multiplication: https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/78489894b25b74684ba62edd4cac749402cfb (mixed fractions; even the Fastest mode was so unpopular that it got deactivated)
